SlideshowForge_Director: Turn an image batch into an editable timeline containing source indices, motion, duration and transition choices. Choose a style preset and total-duration, per-image or beat-sync timing. AUDIO is required for beat-sync mode. A supplied timeline_json_in can replace generation after validation. Returns timeline JSON, source image count and audio for the encoder.
SlideshowForge_GPURenderer: Render the Director's timeline against the same source image batch using PyTorch/Kornia transforms and transitions. Reads canvas and segment settings from timeline_json and samples animation at the requested FPS. Outputs RGB IMAGE frames; connect them to Create Video or VideoHelperSuite. Rendering is procedural and requires no diffusion checkpoint.
